title: add-flash-authoring-lite-workbench
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add a lightweight local-first authoring workbench for quick RAG iteration. Includes devcontainer, telemetry presets, and compact step snapshots for offline debugging.
description:
Title: Add 'Flash' Authoring Lite workbench and quickstart

Summary: This PR introduces a minimal, local-first authoring workbench called 'flash-workbench-lite' aimed at onboarding product and platform engineers to RAG authoring patterns quickly. The workbench is intentionally compact: a single devcontainer-powered sandbox, a small express static shim for previewing playbooks locally, step-snapshot tooling for deterministic replay, and a short how-to with telemetry presets. Motivation: teams asked for a low-friction, offline-capable authoring starter that shows how to wire a prompt template, incremental indexing, and telemetry probes without pulling in the full authoring studio. This is a companion quickstart for the docs site and workshop sessions.

Checklist:
- [x] devcontainer + docker-compose example added
- [x] quickstart README with step-by-step runbook
- [x] compact sample index (FAISS json) + seed corpus
- [x] step-snapshot utility for deterministic replay
- [x] telemetry probes preset and sample dashboard link
- [x] smoke CI for the sandbox start and basic smoke tests

Commits summary: 4 commits - initial scaffold (devcontainer, README, sample data), add snapshot/replay script and telemetry presets, add small express preview shim and sample playbook, CI: add smoke job + fix tests.

Files changed (high level):
- quickstarts/flash-workbench/README.md (new) - includes run instructions, authoring workflow, and local limitations
- quickstarts/flash-workbench/devcontainer.json (new) - VS Code devcontainer definition
- quickstarts/flash-workbench/docker-compose.yml (new) - lightweight local services (mini-indexer + preview shim)
- quickstarts/flash-workbench/sample-index/faiss-seed.json (new) - tiny seed corpus for examples
- quickstarts/flash-workbench/replay/snapshot.ts (new) - TypeScript tool to capture & replay step snapshots
- quickstarts/flash-workbench/telemetry/presets.yaml (new) - telemetry probes & sample Grafana dashboard link
- .github/workflows/quickstart-smoke.yml (modified) - add smoke job for flash-workbench

Small snippets included in PR: README excerpts with example prompt template and a compact docker-compose snippet. No production secrets or env defaults.

Review conversation (high level):
- Arjun Patel (Reviewer): "Nice minimal shape. Can we confirm the snapshot tool does not leak raw file paths and that replay uses seeded RNG to keep determinism? Also prefer .env.template rather than hard-coded vars."
- Maya Chen (Author): "Addressed: snapshot now strips absolute paths and a seeded RNG was added (seed=42 default). Added .env.template and updated README to document env usage."
- Liam O'Connor (Reviewer): "Telemetry presets look fine; suggest a short section in README on what to expect in the dashboard and how to toggle probes off for privacy."
- Maya Chen: "Added privacy toggle section and a note about retained telemetry being optional for workshops."
- Sofia Ruiz (Reviewer): "CI flake on the first run — smoke job timed out in our macos runner. Switched to ubuntu-latest runner and added a 90s startup wait for DB seed. Re-ran and passing."

CI checks summary:
- quickstart-smoke (ubuntu-latest): passed (start -> seed index -> run sample playbook)
- lint (typescript): passed
- docs-link-check: passed
- preview-build: passed

Compatibility notes: The workbench is intentionally small and does not attempt to replace the full authoring studio. It is designed for local experimentation and learning: indexing is ephemeral, and the FAISS JSON is only a toy dataset. The replay/snapshot tool is TypeScript/Node 18+ compatible and has zero external cloud dependencies.

Testing and verification: I manually validated the following flows on ubuntu-22.04 and macOS 13 in a devcontainer: container start, index seed, run sample playbook (tool-calls stubbed), snapshot capture and replay, toggle telemetry probes. CI reproduces the ubuntu flow.

Docs site and workshop impact: The README is authored for direct inclusion into the docs quickstarts page. The PR references a docs site PR that will add a short 'Flash workbench' card to the quickstart gallery and link back to this repository folder. Workshop facilitators can copy the devcontainer for short hands-on labs.

Merge notes: Squash-merged into main after approvals from Arjun, Liam, and Sofia. Changelog: add new quickstart 'flash-workbench' under quickstarts, wire in smoke CI. No migrations required.

Follow-ups (future work):
- Add optional tiny web UI for snippet editing (low priority)
- Add more seed corpora for different domains (finance, docs, product)
- Integrate with local embeddings runner for better parity with hosted indexing

Related Linear items: ENG-4821 (flash-workbench seed), PM-311 (docs quickstart card). Related docs PR: internal-docs#502 (adds gallery card and short tutorial).
